sanskrit_verse:
तत्र त्व् इदम् उपेक्षां वा यः कश्चित् कुरुते नरः ।
चतुःसुवर्णं षण्णिष्कास् तस्य दण्डो विधीयते ॥
transliteration: tatra tv idam upekṣāṃ vā yaḥ kaścit kurute naraḥ | catuḥsuvarṇaṃ ṣaṇṇiṣkās tasya daṇḍo vidhīyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a person neglects or disregards the prescribed duty, especially in matters requiring immediate dharmic response, his capacity to act in alignment with Dharma becomes diminished, necessitating a restorative correction measured by the value of four suvarṇas and six niṣkas.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious alignment with Dharma, not from position or title.
Causation is determined by the degree of conscious neglect or omission.
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to one's awareness and ability to respond.
Restoration logic demands recalibration of consciousness, not punitive suffering.
Consciousness alignment is the ultimate measure of legal validity.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that even at the highest levels of societal authority, conscious disregard of dharma-aligned duties incurs a restorative obligation. The court must assess not just the act but the agent’s capacity and awareness at the time of omission, ensuring alignment with Dharma prevails over procedural formalism.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that neglect arises from misaligned consciousness, not inherent defect. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how neglect manifests through stages of disengagement. Responsibility is proportional to the clarity of dharma at the moment of action. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering is never corrective; only conscious completion restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Conscious Completion Process wherein the individual reaffirms their dharma-aligned role.
Assign Responsibility Assumption Ritual to restore energetic integrity lost through neglect.
Implement Capacity Restoration Module to enhance future dharmic discernment.
Execute Integrity Reintegration Sequence to align personal will with cosmic order.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Justice is executed not for punishment but for the restoration of consciousness. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma is hereby restored. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
